# Municipal Ordinance No. 06, Series of 2024

**Ordinance on the Borrowing of the Municipality of Pitogo in the Amount of Eighty-Four Million Pesos (P84,000,000.00) to Finance Acquisition of Various Heavy Equipment**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]] to borrow the amount of Eighty-Four Million Pesos (P84,000,000.00) for the purpose of financing the acquisition of various heavy equipment for municipal infrastructure projects. The ordinance was enacted under the fiscal powers of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] and was reviewed and declared **valid** by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] under SP Resolution No. 2024-0697. This ordinance is related to [[MO-12-S2024]], which deals with a DBP term loan for similar fiscal purposes.

## Key Provisions

- Authorizes the municipality to contract a loan of P84,000,000.00
- Specifies that the loan proceeds shall be used exclusively for the acquisition of heavy equipment
- Identifies the types of heavy equipment to be acquired
- Provides for the terms and conditions of the borrowing, including repayment schedule
- Designates the source of repayment from municipal revenues

## Provincial Review

The [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of [[Quezon Province]] reviewed this ordinance under **SP Resolution No. 2024-0697** dated July 29, 2024, and declared it **VALID**. The SP authorized the municipality's borrowing in compliance with the requirements of Sections 297 and 299 of RA 7160.
